content.text:
That config file is the culprit: someone set `immutable_heads() = "bookmarks()"` for this repo, which makes every commit reachable from *any* bookmark immutable — including everything under your local `retry-backoff` bookmark, not just `main`. That's why the whole stack past `48a5b66` is locked.

The default jj behavior would use `trunk()`, but since there's no git remote configured here, `trunk()` resolves to nothing. I'll scope immutability to just the `main` bookmark instead.

Done. Root cause: a repo-local config at `~/.config/jj/repos/c74de1f2d5e93c085f05/config.toml` overrode `immutable_heads()` to `bookmarks()`, which made everything under your local `retry-backoff` bookmark immutable too — not just `main`. I changed it to `immutable_heads() = "main"`, which unblocked the stack while keeping `main` (and everything at/before `48a5b66`) immutable.

Then reworded `19cfeaa` → **"handle nonces on retried charges"** (now `b5cec7ae`); jj auto-rebased the two descendant commits (`retry-backoff` and the changelog note) on top.
